localeCode.description: Do not translate. The BCP 47 language tag of this catalog, used to format numbers, dates and plurals.

extName.message: YouTube Hider: hide watched videos, Shorts and low views
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and in chrome://extensions. Max 75 characters. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated and use the words people search for in this language.

extDescription.message: Hides already watched videos from YouTube, as well as low views videos and remove Shorts
extDescription.description: Short description shown in the Chrome Web Store. Max 132 characters.

popupPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the settings page. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

headerSupport.description: Header button that opens the panel about supporting the project. About 10 characters max.

pageHome.description: Per-page toggle for YouTube's Home feed. Use the name YouTube itself shows in this language. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

pageChannel.description: Per-page toggle for channel pages. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

pageSubs.description: Per-page toggle for the Subscriptions feed, abbreviated. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

pageSearch.description: Per-page toggle for search results. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

pageRelated.description: Per-page toggle for the related videos sidebar next to the video being played. Very short: the toggle is about 70px wide.

keepMusicLabel.description: Label of the toggle in the Hide Watched Videos card that exempts videos YouTube labels as music.

markedWatchedLabel.description: Label of the row that shows how many videos were marked as watched by hand.

markedCountNone.description: Shown instead of a count when no video has been marked as watched.

markedWatchedManage.description: Button that opens the page listing the marked videos. One short word.

manageListLabel.description: Accessible name of the Manage button on a list card. The placeholder is the list name, e.g. Channel Blacklist.

contentShorts.description: Toggle label for hiding Shorts. Use YouTube's own name in this language. Very short.

contentMixes.description: Toggle label for hiding Mixes (YouTube's automatic playlists). Use YouTube's own name in this language. Very short.

contentPlaylists.description: Toggle label for hiding playlists. Very short.

contentLives.description: Toggle label for hiding live streams. Very short.

sliderOff.description: Value shown by a slider when it is turned off. One short word.

dateNewerLabel.description: Label of the slider: videos uploaded more recently than the chosen time are hidden.

dateOlderLabel.description: Label of the slider: videos uploaded longer ago than the chosen time are hidden.

channelWhitelistDescription.message: Channels listed here will not be filtered. Shorts are always filtered regardless
channelWhitelistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Channel Whitelist card.

channelListsSyncPaused.message: Sync paused: your lists are too large to sync. Nothing is lost, everything keeps working in this browser
channelListsSyncPaused.description: Amber notice in the Lists tab and in Settings when the lists no longer fit in the sync quota.

channelBlacklistDescription.message: Channels listed here are always hidden, everywhere. Shorts are always filtered regardless
channelBlacklistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Channel Blacklist card.

titleWhitelistTitle.description: Card title. Keep 'Title Whitelist' in English.

titleWhitelistDescription.message: Videos with one of these words in their title will not be filtered
titleWhitelistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Title Whitelist card.

titleBlacklistTitle.description: Card title. Keep 'Title Blacklist' in English.

titleBlacklistDescription.message: Videos with one of these words in their title are always hidden
titleBlacklistDescription.description: Subtitle of the Title Blacklist card.

hideOnPageControlsLabel.description: Toggle label. On-page tooltips and the tutorial quote it, so keep them in step.

hideOnPageControlsDescription.message: Removes the gear, Whitelist, Blacklist and Watched buttons. Filters keep working

tutorialRestart.description: Button that restarts the tutorial. One short word.

tutorialRestartConfirm.message: Done: it starts on your next YouTube visit

footerFeedback.description: Footer link to the feedback form.

footerChangelog.description: Footer link to the list of changes per version.

footerWebsite.description: Footer link to the project website.

supportTitle.description: Title of the support panel. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

supportLead.message: YouTube Hider is free, open source, and has no ads and no tracking. It also aims at a moving target: YouTube reshapes its page markup without warning, and a change nobody announces can quietly break a filter that worked yesterday
supportLead.description: First paragraph of the support panel.

supportText.message: Keeping it working means hunting those changes down one selector at a time, in someone's spare time. Any of these three helps
supportText.description: Second paragraph of the support panel. 'these three' are the three options listed below it.

supportKofiDescription.message: A one-off contribution on Ko-fi. No account and no subscription needed

supportGithubDescription.message: Send a pull request, or report a broken filter with the page it happened on

supportReviewTitle.description: Support option: rate the extension on the Chrome Web Store.

supportReviewDescription.message: A rating on the Chrome Web Store costs nothing and helps other people find the extension

closeLabel.description: Accessible label of a close button.

markedCount_one.description: Number of marked videos and the maximum the list keeps.

markedCount_other.description: Number of marked videos and the maximum the list keeps.

markedCountAlmostFull_one.message: $count$ video of $limit$. Almost full: past the limit, the oldest marks are dropped
markedCountAlmostFull_one.description: Number of marked videos when the list is close to its maximum, with a warning.

markedCountAlmostFull_other.message: $count$ videos of $limit$. Almost full: past the limit, the oldest marks are dropped
markedCountAlmostFull_other.description: Number of marked videos when the list is close to its maximum, with a warning.

markedCountFull_one.message: $count$ video of $limit$. Full: each new mark drops the oldest one
markedCountFull_one.description: Number of marked videos when the list reached its maximum.

markedCountFull_other.message: $count$ videos of $limit$. Full: each new mark drops the oldest one
markedCountFull_other.description: Number of marked videos when the list reached its maximum.

managePageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the page that manages every list, before a tab is picked. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

managePageTitleList.description: Browser tab title of the lists page while one list is open. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

manageHeading.description: Heading next to the logo on the page that manages every list, and the name of its row of tabs.

manageExport.description: Button that downloads every list as one JSON file.

manageImport.description: Button that adds entries from an exported JSON file.

manageSyncHeadlineOk.description: Sync status on the Manage page when everything syncs.

manageSyncHeadlineSyncing.description: Sync status line while a change is being synced.

manageSyncHeadlineAlmostFull.description: Sync status line when the lists use most of the space Chrome allows for syncing.

manageSyncHeadlinePaused.description: Sync status line when the lists are too large to sync.

manageSyncHeadlineMarkedPaused.description: Sync status line when the lists sync but the marked videos do not.

manageSyncHeadlineRetrying.description: Sync status line when the last sync attempt failed and will be retried.

manageSyncHeadlineOutdated.description: Sync status line when another device uses a newer version.

manageSyncRoomLeft_one.description: Estimate shown next to the almost-full sync status: roughly how many more channels or words can still sync.

manageSyncRoomLeft_other.description: Estimate shown next to the almost-full sync status: roughly how many more channels or words can still sync.

manageSyncMessageListsPaused.message: Your lists have outgrown the space Chrome gives extensions to sync, so syncing them is paused. Everything is saved and working in this browser, and your other devices keep the last version that fit. Sync resumes by itself once the lists fit again
manageSyncMessageListsPaused.description: Explanation shown when the lists are too large to sync. It must make clear that nothing is lost.

manageSyncMessageMarkedPaused.message: Your lists come first in the shared sync space. Marked videos are saved and keep working in this browser, and sync resumes once there is room again
manageSyncMessageMarkedPaused.description: Explanation under "Marked videos are not syncing".

manageSyncMessageOutdated.message: Another device uses a newer version of YouTube Hider. Update the extension in this browser to keep syncing
manageSyncMessageOutdated.description: Explanation shown when another device wrote a newer sync format. Keep 'YouTube Hider' untranslated.

manageSyncMessageNearFull.message: If your lists outgrow it, syncing pauses but nothing is lost: everything keeps working in this browser
manageSyncMessageNearFull.description: Explanation under the almost-full sync status. It must make clear that nothing is lost.

manageSyncMeterText.description: Screen reader text for the bar that shows how full the sync space is.

manageUndo.description: Button in the confirmation message that reverts the last change.

manageDismiss.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the confirmation message.

manageExportBackup.description: Link-styled button in the Clear all dialog that downloads a backup first.

manageCancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

manageImportTitle.description: Title of the dialog that previews an import.

manageImportIntro.message: Entries are only added: nothing already in your lists is removed or changed
manageImportIntro.description: Text of the import preview dialog, before the per-list summary.

manageImportNothing.message: Nothing new to import: everything in that file is already in your lists
manageImportNothing.description: Message when an imported file has nothing that is not already in the lists.

manageImportError.message: That file could not be read as a YouTube Hider export
manageImportError.description: Message when the chosen file is not a YouTube Hider export.

manageImportListFull.message: The list is full, so the oldest marks were dropped
manageImportListFull.description: Added after the import message when the marked videos hit their limit.

manageImportConfirm_one.description: Confirm button of the import preview dialog, with the number of new entries.

manageImportConfirm_other.description: Confirm button of the import preview dialog, with the number of new entries.

manageImportSkippedOther_one.description: Import preview: channels skipped because they are already in the opposite list.

manageImportSkippedOther_other.description: Import preview: channels skipped because they are already in the opposite list.

manageMarkedDescription.message: Videos you marked with the Watched button on YouTube. They are hidden like watched videos. Remove one to bring it back. Up to 3,000 videos are kept: past that, the oldest mark is dropped
manageMarkedDescription.description: Intro paragraph of the Marked as watched tab. 'Watched' is the on-page button label (buttonWatched) and 'Hide Watched Videos' the card title (hideWatchedTitle): keep them identical to those translations.

manageMarkedNote.message: Follows $setting$: marked videos are hidden only on the pages where that filter is on
manageMarkedNote.description: Note on the Marked as watched tab. $setting$ is the Watched videos filter name.

manageSwitchOn.description: Visible state next to a list switch when the list is active.

manageSwitchOff.description: Visible state next to a list switch when the list is paused.

manageAddChannelsLabel.description: Label of the box that adds channels to a channel list.

manageAddWordsLabel.description: Label of the box that adds words to a title list.

manageAddChannelsPlaceholder.message: @handle or channel link. Paste several at once, one per line
manageAddChannelsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box that adds channels. '@handle' is YouTube's channel handle.

manageAddWordsPlaceholder.message: Word or phrase. Paste several at once, one per line
manageAddWordsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the box that adds words to a title list.

manageAddChannelsHint.message: Enter adds, Shift+Enter starts a new line. For example @veritasium or youtube.com/@veritasium
manageAddChannelsHint.description: Help text under the box that adds channels. Keep the two examples unchanged.

manageAddWordsHint.message: Enter adds, Shift+Enter starts a new line. A word matches where a word of the title starts, ignoring case
manageAddWordsHint.description: Help text under the box that adds words: keyboard keys and the matching rule.

manageAddButton.description: Add button of the add box while nothing valid is typed.

manageAddButtonCount_one.description: Add button of the add box with the number of entries it will add.

manageAddButtonCount_other.description: Add button of the add box with the number of entries it will add.

manageAddNew_one.description: Preview chip: entries that will be added.

manageAddNew_other.description: Preview chip: entries that will be added.

manageAddExisting_one.description: Preview chip: entries already in this list, which are skipped.

manageAddExisting_other.description: Preview chip: entries already in this list, which are skipped.

manageAddMoving_one.description: Preview chip: channels that are in the opposite list and will be moved here.

manageAddMoving_other.description: Preview chip: channels that are in the opposite list and will be moved here.

manageAdded_one.description: Confirmation after adding entries to a list. The second placeholder is the list name.

manageAdded_other.description: Confirmation after adding entries to a list. The second placeholder is the list name.

manageRemoved_one.description: Confirmation after removing entries from a list. The second placeholder is the list name.

manageRemoved_other.description: Confirmation after removing entries from a list. The second placeholder is the list name.

manageMoved_one.description: Confirmation after moving entries to the opposite list. The second placeholder is the target list name.

manageMoved_other.description: Confirmation after moving entries to the opposite list. The second placeholder is the target list name.

manageMarkedRemoved_one.message: Removed $count$ video. It shows up on YouTube again
manageMarkedRemoved_one.description: Confirmation after removing marked videos; they show up on YouTube again.

manageMarkedRemoved_other.message: Removed $count$ videos. They show up on YouTube again
manageMarkedRemoved_other.description: Confirmation after removing marked videos; they show up on YouTube again.

manageSearchChannels.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box on a channel list.

manageSearchWords.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box on a title list.

manageSearchMarked.message: Search by title, channel or video ID
manageSearchMarked.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the search box on the Marked as watched tab.

manageCountChannels_one.description: Number of channels in a list.

manageCountChannels_other.description: Number of channels in a list.

manageCountWords_one.description: Number of words or phrases in a title list.

manageCountWords_other.description: Number of words or phrases in a title list.

manageCountMatches_one.description: Number of entries matching the search.

manageCountMatches_other.description: Number of entries matching the search.

manageSelectedCount_one.description: Number of selected entries, shown in the list header while a selection exists.

manageSelectedCount_other.description: Number of selected entries, shown in the list header while a selection exists.

manageSelectAllMatching_one.description: Link that extends the selection from the loaded rows to every matching entry.

manageSelectAllMatching_other.description: Link that extends the selection from the loaded rows to every matching entry.

manageSelectShown.description: Accessible name of the checkbox that selects every loaded row.

manageClearSelection.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that clears the selection.

manageSelectItem.description: Accessible name of the checkbox of one row. The placeholder is the channel, word or video title.

manageRemoveItem.description: Accessible name of the Remove button of one row. The placeholder is the channel, word or video title.

manageRemoveSelected_one.description: Button that removes every selected entry, with how many are selected.

manageRemoveSelected_other.description: Button that removes every selected entry, with how many are selected.

manageMoveSelected.description: Button that moves the selected entries to the opposite list. The placeholder is that list name.

manageClearSearch.description: Button shown when a search has no results.

manageLoadMore_one.description: Button that shows the next rows, with how many are left.

manageLoadMore_other.description: Button that shows the next rows, with how many are left.

manageClearAll.description: Button at the bottom of a list that empties it, after a confirmation.

manageClearTitle.description: Title of the dialog confirming Clear all. The placeholder is the list name.

manageClearText_one.message: This removes $count$ entry from $list$. You can undo it right after, or export a backup first
manageClearText_one.description: Text of the dialog confirming Clear all.

manageClearText_other.message: This removes all $count$ entries from $list$. You can undo it right after, or export a backup first
manageClearText_other.description: Text of the dialog confirming Clear all.

manageClearConfirm_one.description: Confirm button of the Clear all dialog.

manageClearConfirm_other.description: Confirm button of the Clear all dialog.

manageEmptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of a list with no entries.

manageEmptyMarked.message: No videos marked yet. On YouTube, hover a video and click Watched to add it here
manageEmptyMarked.description: Empty state of the Marked as watched tab. 'Watched' is the on-page button label (buttonWatched).

manageEmptyChannelWhitelist.message: Use the Whitelist button next to Subscribe on a channel or video page, or paste channels in the box above
manageEmptyChannelWhitelist.description: Empty state of the Channel Whitelist tab: the ways to add a channel. 'Whitelist' is the on-page button label and 'Subscribe' YouTube's own button: use YouTube's word for it.

manageEmptyChannelBlacklist.message: Hover a video on YouTube and click Blacklist, use the Blacklist button next to Subscribe on a channel page, or paste channels in the box above
manageEmptyChannelBlacklist.description: Empty state of the Channel Blacklist tab: the ways to add a channel. 'Blacklist' is the on-page button label and 'Subscribe' YouTube's own button: use YouTube's word for it.

manageEmptyTitleWhitelist.message: Type a word or phrase in the box above. Videos whose title contains it are never filtered
manageEmptyTitleWhitelist.description: Empty state of the Title Whitelist tab.

manageEmptyTitleBlacklist.message: Type a word or phrase in the box above. Videos whose title contains it are always hidden
manageEmptyTitleBlacklist.description: Empty state of the Title Blacklist tab.

manageNoMatchTitle.description: Title of the empty state when a search finds nothing. The placeholder is the search text.

manageNoMatchText.message: Check the spelling, or search for just part of the name
manageNoMatchText.description: Text of the empty state when a search finds nothing.

manageChannelIdLabel.description: Small label under a channel saved by its ID instead of its handle.

manageTitleUnavailable.message: Title not available on this device
manageTitleUnavailable.description: Shown instead of a marked video title this device does not know yet.

manageMarkedOn.description: Date a video was marked as watched. The placeholder is the formatted date.

headerButtonLabel.description: Accessible label and hover title of the gear button added to YouTube's header.

buttonWhitelist.description: On-page button that adds a channel to the Channel Whitelist. Keep 'Whitelist' in English. Shown on small thumbnails: keep it short.

buttonWhitelisted.description: On-page button state next to Subscribe when the channel is on the Channel Whitelist. Must contain 'Whitelist' in English.

buttonResumeWhitelist.description: On-page button shown when the channel is listed but the whole Channel Whitelist is turned off. Keep 'Whitelist' in English.

buttonBlacklist.description: On-page button that adds a channel to the Channel Blacklist. Keep 'Blacklist' in English. Shown on small thumbnails: keep it short.

buttonBlacklisted.description: On-page button state next to Subscribe when the channel is on the Channel Blacklist. Must contain 'Blacklist' in English.

buttonUnblacklist.description: Button on a dimmed video that removes its channel from the Channel Blacklist. Keep 'Unblacklist' in English.

buttonUndo.description: Label of an on-page button during its 3 second countdown, before the action is saved. One short word: it shares the button with a countdown ring.

buttonWatched.description: On-page button shown over a video thumbnail on hover, marks the video as watched. One short word.

buttonWatchedTitle.message: Mark as watched: hides this video like one you already watched
buttonWatchedTitle.description: Hover title of the Watched button.

buttonWatchedPendingTitle.message: Cancel marking this video as watched
buttonWatchedPendingTitle.description: Hover title of the Watched button during its countdown.

buttonUnmark.description: Button on a video dimmed because it was marked as watched, removes the mark. One short word.

buttonUnmarkTitle.message: Remove the watched mark from this video
buttonUnmarkTitle.description: Hover title of the Unmark button.

tooltipOnPageControls.message: You can hide this button from the extension settings, under "$setting$"
tooltipOnPageControls.description: Last sentence of the on-page Whitelist and Blacklist button tooltips.

tooltipWhitelistAddOne.message: Adds this channel to your YouTube Hider whitelist: its videos won't be filtered (Shorts are always filtered)
tooltipWhitelistAddOne.description: Tooltip of the Whitelist button next to Subscribe, for one channel.

tooltipWhitelistAddMany.message: Adds these channels to your YouTube Hider whitelist: their videos won't be filtered (Shorts are always filtered)
tooltipWhitelistAddMany.description: Tooltip of the Whitelist button next to Subscribe, for a video made by several channels together.

tooltipWhitelistRemoveOne.message: Removes this channel from your YouTube Hider whitelist
tooltipWhitelistRemoveOne.description: Tooltip of the Whitelisted button, for one channel.

tooltipWhitelistRemoveMany.message: Removes these channels from your YouTube Hider whitelist
tooltipWhitelistRemoveMany.description: Tooltip of the Whitelisted button, for a video made by several channels together.

tooltipWhitelistPaused.message: This whitelist entry exists, but Channel Whitelist is currently turned off. Click to turn it back on
tooltipWhitelistPaused.description: Tooltip of the Resume Whitelist button. Keep 'Channel Whitelist' in English.

tooltipBlacklistAddOne.message: Adds this channel to your YouTube Hider blacklist: its videos will always be hidden (Shorts are always filtered)
tooltipBlacklistAddOne.description: Tooltip of the Blacklist button next to Subscribe, for one channel.

tooltipBlacklistAddMany.message: Adds these channels to your YouTube Hider blacklist: their videos will always be hidden (Shorts are always filtered)
tooltipBlacklistAddMany.description: Tooltip of the Blacklist button next to Subscribe, for a video made by several channels together.

tooltipBlacklistRemoveOne.message: Removes this channel from your YouTube Hider blacklist
tooltipBlacklistRemoveOne.description: Tooltip of the Blacklisted button, for one channel.

tooltipBlacklistRemoveMany.message: Removes these channels from your YouTube Hider blacklist
tooltipBlacklistRemoveMany.description: Tooltip of the Blacklisted button, for a video made by several channels together.

reasonAlreadyWatched.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: you watched it past the chosen percentage. Short, it sits on a thumbnail.

reasonMarkedWatched.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: you marked it with the Watched button. Short, it sits on a thumbnail.

reasonVideoTooNew.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: uploaded more recently than the Upload Date Filter allows. Short.

reasonVideoTooOld.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: uploaded longer ago than the Upload Date Filter allows. Short.

reasonViewsTooLow.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: fewer views than the Views Filter minimum. Short.

reasonViewsTooHigh.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video: more views than the Views Filter maximum. Short.

reasonMixPlaylist.description: Reason shown on a dimmed Mix (YouTube's automatic playlist). Use YouTube's own name. Short.

reasonPlaylist.description: Reason shown on a dimmed playlist. Short.

reasonLiveStream.description: Reason shown on a dimmed live stream. Short.

reasonBlacklistedChannel.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video whose channel is on the Channel Blacklist. Must contain 'Blacklist' in English. Short.

reasonBlacklistedWord.description: Reason shown on a dimmed video whose title matches the Title Blacklist. Must contain 'Blacklist' in English.

tourWelcomeTitle.description: Title of the first-run welcome card. Keep YouTube Hider untranslated.

tourWelcomeDescription.message: A $count$-step tour of where your settings are and how to use them. It takes about a minute
tourWelcomeDescription.description: Text of the welcome card. $count$ is the number of tour steps.

tourStart.description: Button on the welcome card that starts the tour.

tourBack.description: Tour button that goes to the previous step.

tourNext.description: Tour button that goes to the next step.

tourDone.description: Tour button on the last step that closes the tour.

tourStepCount.description: Progress badge at the top of each tour step.

sentenceJoin.description: Joins two complete sentences into one text, as in the on-page button tooltips. UI sentences never end with a period, so this is the only place the separator between two sentences comes from. Use the sentence separator of this language.

first.example: Adds this channel to your YouTube Hider whitelist

second.example: You can hide this button from the extension settings

stateOn.description: Label next to the master switch in the popup header when the extension is on.

stateOff.description: Label next to the master switch in the popup header when the extension is off.

extensionSwitchLabel.description: Accessible name of the master switch that turns the whole extension on or off.

offTitle.description: Title of the banner shown at the top of the popup while the extension is switched off. Keep YouTube Hider untranslated.

offText.message: Nothing is filtered. Your settings and lists are kept
offText.description: Second line of the banner shown while the extension is switched off.

offTurnOn.description: Button in the off banner that switches the extension back on.

offNote.message: Changes you make here apply once it is on
offNote.description: Note above the settings while the extension is switched off.

tabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of tabs at the top of the popup.

tabLists.description: Popup tab with the Whitelist and Blacklist lists.

tabSettings.description: Popup tab with the remaining settings.

contextYouAreOn.description: Context bar at the top of the popup. $page$ is shown in bold: a page name such as "Home", a channel handle such as "@veritasium", or "a video".

contextPageHome.description: Page name used in "You are on $page$" for the YouTube home feed. Use the name YouTube shows.

contextPageSubs.description: Page name used in "You are on $page$" for the Subscriptions feed. Use the name YouTube shows.

contextPageSearch.description: Page name used in "You are on $page$" for YouTube search results.

contextPageVideo.description: Page name used in "You are on $page$" while a video is playing.

contextPageChannel.description: Page name used in "You are on $page$" on a channel page whose handle is not known.

contextNotYouTube.message: Open YouTube to see which filters apply
contextNotYouTube.description: Context bar text when the current tab is not a YouTube page.

contextOtherPage.message: Filters do not apply on this page
contextOtherPage.description: Context bar text on a YouTube page that no filter applies to, such as the history.

contextFiltersHere_one.description: Right side of the context bar: how many filters are active on the current page.

contextFiltersHere_other.description: Right side of the context bar: how many filters are active on the current page.

contextFiltersSidebar_one.description: Right side of the context bar on a video page, where filters only apply to the related videos next to the player.

contextFiltersSidebar_other.description: Right side of the context bar on a video page, where filters only apply to the related videos next to the player.

contextNoFiltersHere.description: Right side of the context bar when no filter is active on the current page.

filterModeGroupLabel.description: Accessible name of the Hidden / Dimmed choice.

filterModeLead.description: Text before the Hidden / Dimmed choice. The choice completes the sentence: "Filtered videos are Hidden".

filterModeHidden.description: Option of the filter mode choice: filtered videos are removed from the page.

filterModeDimmed.description: Option of the filter mode choice: filtered videos stay on the page under a dark overlay.

filterWatchedTitle.description: Title of the filter that hides videos you already watched.

filterViewsTitle.description: Title of the filter that hides videos by their view count.

filterDateTitle.description: Title of the filter that hides videos by their upload date.

watchedSliderLabel.description: Label of the watch percentage slider.

viewsMinLabel.description: Label of the slider that hides videos with fewer views than the value.

viewsMaxLabel.description: Label of the slider that hides videos with more views than the value.

viewsHint.message: Keeps videos between the two limits. Set one to Off to skip it
viewsHint.description: Explanation at the top of the open View count filter.

dateHint.message: Use one limit, or both to keep only videos from a time window
dateHint.description: Explanation at the top of the open Upload date filter.

viewsOverlapWarning.message: $over$ must be higher than $under$. Paused until you fix it
viewsOverlapWarning.description: Warning when the View count limits overlap. $over$ and $under$ are the two slider labels.

dateOverlapWarning.message: $older$ must be longer than $newer$. Paused until you fix it
dateOverlapWarning.description: Warning when the Upload date limits overlap. $older$ and $newer$ are the two slider labels.

summaryWatched.description: Summary under the Watched videos title. $percent$ is a formatted percentage.

summaryViewsUnder.description: Summary under the View count title. $views$ is a compact number such as 1K.

summaryViewsOver.description: Summary under the View count title when only the upper limit is set.

summaryViewsBetween.description: Summary under the View count title when both limits are set: videos outside the range are hidden.

summaryDateNewer.description: Summary under the Upload date title when only "Hide newer than" is set. $age$ is a duration such as "1 week".

summaryDateOlder.description: Summary under the Upload date title when only "Hide older than" is set. $age$ is a duration such as "1 year".

summaryDateWindow.description: Summary under the Upload date title when both limits are set: only videos uploaded between the two ages stay.

summaryAllPages.description: Summary part when a filter applies on every page.

summaryPages.description: Summary part: on how many of the pages a filter applies.

summaryOverlap.description: Summary shown in red when the two limits of a filter overlap and the filter does nothing.

summaryNoPages.description: Summary shown in red when a filter is on but no page is selected.

applyOnLabel.description: Label above the page chips of a filter.

chipAllPages.description: Chip that selects or clears every page at once.

relatedHint.message: Related is the sidebar next to the video you are watching

keepMusicHint.message: Songs you already heard stay in the feed

formatsTitle.description: Title of the card with the Shorts, Mixes, Playlists and Lives switches.

shortsInSearchLabel.description: Switch that also hides Shorts in search results.

channelCardLabel.description: Small label above the channel handle in the Lists tab.

channelsOnVideo_one.description: Small label above the list of channels of a video made by several channels together.

channelsOnVideo_other.description: Small label above the list of channels of a video made by several channels together.

channelCardEmpty.message: Open a channel or a video to whitelist or blacklist its channel from here
channelCardEmpty.description: Lists tab, when the current page has no channel.

statusNotInList.description: Status of the current channel when it is in neither list.

statusInWhitelist.description: Status of the current channel when it is in the Channel Whitelist.

statusInWhitelistPaused.description: Status of the current channel when it is in the Channel Whitelist and the list is paused.

statusInBlacklist.description: Status of the current channel when it is in the Channel Blacklist.

statusInBlacklistPaused.description: Status of the current channel when it is in the Channel Blacklist and the list is paused.

actionWhitelistChannel.description: Button that adds the current channel to the Channel Whitelist.

actionBlacklistChannel.description: Button that adds the current channel to the Channel Blacklist.

actionRemove.description: Button that removes the channel from the list it is in.

actionRemoveFromList.description: Accessible name of the Remove button for a channel.

actionMoveToList.description: Accessible name of the button that moves a channel to the other list.

actionWhitelistNamed.description: Accessible name of the Whitelist button for one channel of a video.

actionBlacklistNamed.description: Accessible name of the Blacklist button for one channel of a video.

wordBoxLabel.message: Match a word in video titles
wordBoxLabel.description: Label of the box that adds a word to the Title Whitelist or the Title Blacklist.

wordAlreadyInList.description: Shown under the word box when the typed word is already listed. $word$ may be shortened with an ellipsis.

wordAdded.description: Shown under the word box after a word was added.

yourListsLabel.description: Accessible name of the card with the five list rows.

countChannelsNeverFiltered_one.description: Status of the Channel Whitelist row.

countChannelsNeverFiltered_other.description: Status of the Channel Whitelist row.

countChannelsAlwaysHidden_one.description: Status of the Channel Blacklist row.

countChannelsAlwaysHidden_other.description: Status of the Channel Blacklist row.

countWordsNeverFiltered_one.description: Status of the Title Whitelist row.

countWordsNeverFiltered_other.description: Status of the Title Whitelist row.

countWordsAlwaysHidden_one.description: Status of the Title Blacklist row.

countWordsAlwaysHidden_other.description: Status of the Title Blacklist row.

listPausedChannels_one.description: Status of a channel list row while the list is paused.

listPausedChannels_other.description: Status of a channel list row while the list is paused.

listPausedWords_one.description: Status of a title list row while the list is paused.

listPausedWords_other.description: Status of a title list row while the list is paused.

listNoChannels.description: Status of an empty channel list row.

listNoWords.description: Status of an empty title list row.

markedFollowsWatched_one.description: Status of the Marked as watched row. "Watched videos" is the name of the filter these marks follow.

markedFollowsWatched_other.description: Status of the Marked as watched row. "Watched videos" is the name of the filter these marks follow.

markedNoneFollowsWatched.message: No videos yet, follows Watched videos
markedNoneFollowsWatched.description: Status of the Marked as watched row when no video is marked.

markedNearLimit.message: $count$ of $limit$: the oldest drop off past that
markedNearLimit.description: Amber status of the Marked as watched row near the 3,000 limit.

markedSyncPausedShort.message: Sync paused: saved in this browser
markedSyncPausedShort.description: Amber status of the Marked as watched row when its sync is paused.

settingsOnYouTube.description: Group title in the Settings tab.

settingsSync.description: Group title in the Settings tab.

settingsHelp.description: Group title in the Settings tab.

syncOk.description: Sync status in the Settings tab when everything syncs.

tourLabel.description: Settings row that restarts the first-run tour.

tourRestartHint.message: Shows again on your next YouTube visit

tourNotNow.description: Button on the welcome card that skips the tour.

tourSkipLabel.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the close button of the tour.

tourRestartNote.message: You can restart it anytime from $settings$
tourRestartNote.description: Small note at the bottom of the welcome card. $settings$ is the name of the Settings tab.

tourGearTitle.description: Tour step 1 title, pointing at the gear button in the YouTube header.

tourGearBody.message: This gear sits in YouTube's own header, on every page. Click it to open YouTube Hider
tourGearBody.description: Tour step 1 text. Keep YouTube Hider untranslated.

tourFiltersTitle.description: Tour step 2 title, pointing at the filter rows.

tourFiltersBody.message: Switch a filter on, then open it to choose the pages it works on. Filters start on every page, so you only open one to make an exception

tourListsTitle.description: Tour step 3 title, pointing at the channel card in the Lists tab.

tourListsBody.message: On a channel or a video, $lists$ shows its channel. Whitelist it to never filter its videos, or Blacklist it to hide them everywhere. $manage$ opens the full lists
tourListsBody.description: Tour step 3 text. $lists$ is the Lists tab name, $manage$ the Manage button label.

tourVideoTitle.description: Tour step 4 title, about the buttons on a video thumbnail.

tourVideoBody.message: When you hover a video, two buttons appear on its thumbnail: $watched$ hides that video, $blacklist$ hides its channel everywhere. Want them gone? Turn on $setting$ in $settings$
tourVideoBody.description: Tour step 4 text. $watched$ and $blacklist$ are the button labels, $setting$ the Hide on-page controls label, $settings$ the Settings tab name.

manageAddInvalid_one.description: Red chip under the add box: how many entries could not be read as a channel.

manageAddInvalid_other.description: Red chip under the add box: how many entries could not be read as a channel.

manageInvalidShow_one.message: Show the entry that was not recognized
manageInvalidShow_one.description: Expandable line under the add box that lists the entries that could not be read.

manageInvalidShow_other.message: Show the $count$ entries that were not recognized
manageInvalidShow_other.description: Expandable line under the add box that lists the entries that could not be read.

manageInvalidBareWord.message: Not a channel. Add @ for a handle
manageInvalidBareWord.description: Reason next to an entry that is a single word without @.

manageInvalidNotYouTube.description: Reason next to an entry that links to a site other than YouTube.

manageInvalidVideoLink.description: Reason next to an entry that links to a video instead of a channel.

manageInvalidNotChannel.description: Reason next to any other entry that could not be read as a channel.

manageInvalidNote.message: After you add, these stay in the box so you can fix them. Words go in the $list$ instead
manageInvalidNote.description: Note under the list of unrecognized entries. $list$ is the Title Whitelist or the Title Blacklist.

manageCurrentChannelBadge.description: Badge on the row of the channel open in the tab you came from.
